best_find.rationale: IsoSphere pairs a specific research-supply problem with early buyer conversations. Its TUM profile reports over 60 customer interviews and 14 letters of intent. An interview names both founders, and MIT's prize programme independently lists the team. The partner identities, order values and conversion of those letters into paid work remain unverified.
best_find.next_check: Ask the team how many letters of intent have converted to paid pilots, confirm production readiness and pricing, and verify incorporation and prior equity financing with primary records.
